impact: A sharp intraday washout followed by a strong recovery is less damaging than first reported for MU, DRAM, SNXX, NBIS, PLTR and GOOGL/MSFT, but the volatility shows how fragile the AI trade is; Friday's thin holiday session could still swing either way.
summary: Correction: our earlier figures were intraday, not the close. Per AP's closing tally, on Wednesday the S&P 500 fell 0.3% to 7,182.78 after being down as much as 3.2%, the Nasdaq Composite fell 0.6% to 23,585.80, the Dow rose 0.3% to 50,182.95 and the Russell 2000 rose 0.7%. Intraday, the Nasdaq had tumbled more than 4% and the Nasdaq 100 briefly fell 20% below its record, as hot core PCE, the new tariff proposal and AI-spending doubts hit chips; Micron, AMD and Nvidia were among the hardest hit during the session. Markets are shut Thursday and close early at 1 p.m. ET Friday.
title: Correction: stocks claw back most losses into Thanksgiving; Nasdaq closes down 0.6% after 4%+ intraday drop
